response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT sc.zoneref AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY sc.zoneref, s.insurstat) SELECT site_reference, insurance_status, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS fraction FROM counts ORDER BY fraction DESC, insurance_status IS NULL, site_reference LIMIT 10;
